supersededByCheckpoint.title: MOIS Region-Clause Precision correction ONLY
supersededByCheckpoint.summary: Found + fixed a real false-positive: findProvinceRegionSpecs scanned every province mention in the whole MOIS text with zero binding to a residence signal (unlike the already-correct lone-city path), so an unrelated later clause describing INTERVIEW/EMPLOYER location (e.g. '서울, 경기, 인천 소재 기업 면접 응시자') was incorrectly absorbed into the applicant's residence rule. Fixed via a positive-binding requirement (existing char-proximity window OR same '○'-delimited MOIS clause). See docs/audits/mois-region-binding-precision.json (frozen 10,967-record catalog before/after) and docs/audits/mois-region-top10-impact.json (Top-10/Top-20 impact, all 6 profiles).
supersededByCheckpoint.residualFindingOutOfScope: This fix targets ONLY the cross-'○'-clause binding gap. Auditing Top-20 Home results post-fix (scripts/auditMoisRegionTop10Impact.ts) surfaced a DIFFERENT, PRE-EXISTING, UNCHANGED-BY-THIS-FIX bug shape still present in Home Top-10 for 2/6 profiles (mois-401000000112, mois-569000000375: illustrative '(예시) 서울시 소재 학교...' comparison text inside the SAME single ○-clause as the true residence signal gets absorbed, because there is no clause boundary to bind against). Verified byte-identical extraction before/after this checkpoint's fix (same bug, not a regression). Left unfixed as out of scope; tracked as a new P1 issue below for the next checkpoint.

moisRegionParserFinalCloseoutCheckpoint.title: Damoa MOIS Region Parser — Final Closeout Fix
moisRegionParserFinalCloseoutCheckpoint.type: REAL_CODE_FIX (not audit-only); closes the checkpoint left open by Addendum 2
fixesLanded: Safe same-field anaphora recovery: single unambiguous province anchor + later deictic back-reference, and named region-list groups + whole-set back-reference (no service-ID special casing)
parseRegionClause returns { unresolved: text } instead of undefined when a real residence signal can't be safely anchored (narrow, deictic-phrase-gated)
New exclusions: illustrative (예시) spans, non-residence institution/location mentions (학교/대학/기업/사업장 소재), embedded province/brand literal tokens
Fixed a previously-undiscovered gap: findLoneCityCandidates lacked the same institution/example/brand exclusion gate already applied to province-level scanning
Compass sub-region (경기북부/남부/동부/서부) and list-delimiter refinements to bare-경기 disambiguation

unchangedDataLimitation.reason: Both old and new parser produce no region rule for this record; the only textual anchor is the brand name 경남바로서비스, which Section 7's design requires excluding via the brand-literal list. Documented, unavoidable data limitation, not a parser regression (same category as the accepted 357000000131 exception).
